scanner_doubts: amss3.md:291,349,450,506,516 - qe-math-010 (proposed) is reported with **no** violations for this lecture, but expectations are written as bare `E` and `E_t` throughout (`\beta E_{t-1} u_{c,t}` at 291, `\beta E( E_t u_{c,t+1})` at 349, `E {\mathcal X_\tau}` at 450, 506, 516), and variance and covariance as `{\rm var}^\infty` / `{\rm cov}^\infty` (324, 337, 361, 481, 487, 494). In `check_math_010` the bare-letter branch is gated on `e_is_operator`, which only arms when a bare `E` is followed by `[` or `\{` - this lecture always applies `E` with parentheses or by juxtaposition, so the gate never arms. The `{\rm var}` / `{\rm cov}` spellings escape the `other` pattern too, because it matches `\mathrm{Var}`/`\text{Cov}` and not `{\rm var}` in lower case. This looks like a systemic miss rather than a clean lecture, and it will affect the whole AMSS family, which shares this notation
